label: techlog-probe
_why: Probe ONLY: does on_acquired_technology fire for every country, and which spelling of the scope:technology accessor resolves? Three candidates are emitted on separate lines so a bad one voids only itself. No vanilla localization uses scope:technology, so this cannot be settled by reading the game files.
_note: Round 2. Round 1 settled the scope: SCOPE.sTechnology('technology') RESOLVES, only the getter failed (engine: could not find data system function 'GetKey'). These three are method-name candidates on that confirmed scope. One in-game year suffices - 436 acquisitions fire at the 1836 start alone.
